problem.statement: Find the kth largest value using a min-heap of size k.

nums.meaning: The sequence of values to process.

k.meaning: The requested largest-value rank and maximum heap size.

heap.meaning: A min-heap containing the largest values retained from the processed prefix.

num.meaning: The value currently being processed from nums.

representation_requirements.description: Represent nums in processing order and identify the current num.
Represent heap as a min-heap whose root is its minimum value.
Represent the size of heap relative to k during processing.
Represent inserting num before removing the minimum when heap exceeds size k.
Represent the minimum element of heap as the final kth-largest value.

semantic_invariants.statement: Among k retained values, the minimum value is the kth largest of those values.
After initialization and each completed update, heap contains no more than k values.
Immediately after inserting num, heap contains the prior retained values plus num before size correction.
After size correction for each processed prefix, heap contains the k largest values in that prefix when the prefix has at least k values, and otherwise contains all prefix values.
After all nums are processed with valid 1 <= k <= len(nums), the minimum element of heap is the kth largest value.

completion_evidence.description: The response connects the kth-largest rank to the minimum of the retained top-k values.
The response represents heap initialization and its size bound relative to k.
The response states or applies insertion of each current num before size correction.
The response traces removal of the minimum whenever heap exceeds size k and preserves the top-k invariant.
The response identifies the minimum element of the final heap as the requested value.

terminal_behavior: Process each num in nums by inserting it into heap.
Whenever heap contains more than k values, remove its minimum value before continuing.
After nums is exhausted, return the minimum element of heap as the kth largest value for valid 1 <= k <= len(nums).
